findings.title: Equality lookup without an explicit LIMIT assumes ID uniqueness
findings.description: WHERE ID = #{id,jdbcType=INTEGER} returns every row matching the value; if ID is not a primary key or unique column, more than one row can be returned even though the surrounding code may expect a single row. Whether a duplicate can actually occur is unverified (requires unique-constraint metadata).
findings.recommendation: Confirm ID has a primary-key/unique constraint on COMPANY, or add LIMIT 1 (e.g. FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY) if the contract is a single row.

findings.title: Index usage for the ID predicate is unverified
findings.description: A point lookup benefits from a unique index on ID; without one the plan may degrade to a scan. This is an unverified claim that requires index metadata or an explained plan.
findings.recommendation: Verify the unique index on ID via database metadata or EXPLAIN tooling outside this review; this does not require executing the reviewed statement.
